status: Initial-state geometry review with authored design intent. Not a human playtest or a complete quest walkthrough. Homefields geometry refreshed from actual v2.234 scene; other maps retain their earlier captures.

maps.title: Briar Town · Homefields
maps.idea: A village and its working farmland, divided by one real millrace. Home, treatment, mill and escape gate form the northward journey.
maps.protect: Keep the millrace open. Broad soil may catch ordinary falls, but must not replace the working bridge. The western ford remains a separate route.
maps.review: Briar journey pass implemented: joined earth trails and destination boards, a physical crate/plate west of the mill, and a lowering crossing on the main trail at x=180. Normal movement checks cover Thomas to the wagon gate plus the granary and orchard climbs. Large farm loops remain. Human pacing feedback remains outstanding. v2.234 repair: store uses a level front doorway; orchard picking stairs rise 7–9 units per 32–34-unit tread. Working walkway and ground return remain separate. Scale, gates and protected gaps are retained.

maps.idea: Clearings around an occupied camp and a signal tower. The ground approach and a genuine canopy crossing meet at the same objective.
maps.protect: Preserve the gaps between canopy perches and the tower descent. Trees frame clearings, not invisible barriers across the walking lanes.
maps.review: Briar journey pass implemented: signed ground and canopy approaches, ground-storey signal guards and joined forest trails. Physical traversal checks cover both signal routes and the loft shard, followed by the Brute encounter. Existing side rescues and perch gaps remain. This is not a human playtest.

maps.idea: An interrupted freight road across a canyon. Transport evidence, loaded cart, bridge and lookout share a believable trade route.
maps.protect: No ground across the freight ravine; the two land masses stay separate. Preserve upper-route gaps and access to the bridge controls.
maps.review: Winding Cliffs finishing pass implemented: joined trade road, five destination boards, clear bridge approach, detailed wagon and correctly placed winch. maps.title: Hollow Pass · Lost Canyon
maps.idea: Occupied holding yards connected by service roads. Entry choice leads to two rescue locations, then a controlled escape.
maps.protect: Preserve the gate, side entry, freight brake and cave approach. Ground the yards without flattening the roof or upper return route.
maps.review: Finishing pass implemented: signed service roads avoid cage footprints and return before the escape gate. Fitted cage sides are solid, the escort clears the doorway, and forced-entry guards approach from the accessible ramp. Detailed signal winch, cut cable and lanterns show the alarm state. Three entries, ground routes, both climbs, escort damage/retry, old save and local co-op checked; human pacing remains unverified.

maps.title: Ruined Keep · Broken Walls
maps.idea: A real fortress: outer court, breach court and inner ward inside stepped curtain walls. The optional workshop and battlements have identifiable entrances.
maps.protect: Side walls must meet the quest gates. The workshop has one purposeful entrance. Preserve the bell climb and upper wheel as real elevation choices.
maps.review: Broken Walls finishing pass verified: full-scale courts retain both prison routes and optional climbs. Bell moved beside the escape lane; six towers have collision, with the breach pair moved clear of the battlement stairs. Joined paving, six signs, visible mechanisms and exact latch timing guide the journey. Physical traversal, live prisoner damage/retry, local host/guest progression and a genuine previous-version save passed. Human pacing and new-player comprehension remain untested.

maps.idea: A cell block, hidden holding room, lift shaft, upper refuge and lower service works. Floor layers matter more than the overhead silhouette.
maps.protect: Keep the shaft open and all lower passages clear. Do not add a shared staircase that makes the prisoner lift pointless; the player can use narrow service routes.

Main and optional routes were physically traversed; local co-op and old-save checks pass. Pacing and enjoyment still need human playtesting.

maps.title: Castle Duskmoor · Long Ascent
maps.idea: Two immense revolutions up a masonry tower, with side service rooms and exposed broken flights. The destination sits high above the entrance.
maps.protect: Keep every deliberate stair gap and exposed detour. Supports must not fill the tower interior or erase lower floors. Inspect one elevation band at a time.
maps.review: Finishing pass: Floor-specific spiral landing signs and guide points; keep every broken flight. Overhead overlap is intentional here, not a shortcut. The height profile and sliced map expose the two revolutions; normal-camera checks still decide whether the climb feels epic.
